The pAUC and H6 CIs are wide relative to the 0.36 false-alarm range, so 'indistinguishable' / 'trace the same curve' means a non-detection at this n; the text should say that, not imply equivalence.

Power: the preregistration (PREREGISTRATION.md Power) projected SE(b)=0.064 and a detectable effect of about 0.16 at 100 per stratum; the realized HC3 SE is 0.078 with 90 UNSOLVED and only 6 contest UNSOLVED problems, so the detectable b is about 0.18, above the point estimate 0.12. The abstract does report H1 as inconclusive; the contribution list (1) frames the stratified test as showing the effect is on unsolved problems, but the interaction was not established and SOLVED d is also positive (+0.06, unadjusted p 0.016). Word it as 'present on UNSOLVED, not shown to be larger than on SOLVED'.

Sonnet: 'The pattern repeated' (main.tex sec. C3) holds for H1u and H2u only. The solvability interaction did not (b -0.02; unadjusted +0.07 [-0.03,+0.18]) and strata are haiku-defined, so sonnet's UNSOLVED stratum is not defined by sonnet's own inability. Sonnet's H4 sign is opposite to haiku's (dJ +0.17), so 'for both models the pooled format went with more choosing' is the only common finding, and the paper's phrase 'consistent with a criterion shift' rests on a haiku dJ interval [-0.26,+0.09] that includes a quarter-point loss of discrimination (the paper does say this).

Abstract says a forced choice selected 'the wrong solution haiku's own isolated verification accepts most'. H2 is a mean difference in accept rate between the picked and the other two wrong candidates (+0.19), not an argmax over candidates; reword to 'more often than the other wrong solutions'.

Multiplicity: Holm is applied within families (haiku C3 four tests; sonnet C3 four; H3; H4 per model; H6/H7), with no correction across families, about 13 confirmatory tests in all. Haiku H1u and H2u (p<0.001) would survive a 13-fold Bonferroni; sonnet H1u (raw p about 0.003) would sit at about 0.04, borderline. State that no cross-family adjustment was made.

Deviations from PREREGISTRATION.md: 'Items are used once' is broken by A4/A5, which reuse the same 227 problems; A4 and A5 were written after the earlier data and in response to reviews, so they are preregistered relative to their own calls but not independent of C3 data. A4 H4 uses only the 214 problems with a TP pool (78 of 90 UNSOLVED) and complete cases. The A4 ISO 'hit' requires accepting the right candidate and rejecting both wrong ones, which is a stricter conjunctive definition than PICK's hit; it is as preregistered, but it lowers ISO hit by construction, and the paper should say hit_PICK - hit_ISO partly reflects this. All of this is disclosed or visible in AMENDMENTS.md; none changes a stated conclusion.

Unit of analysis is the problem (correct), but SEs are not clustered on shared wrong candidates or competition (only fixed effects), and strata come from two haiku attempts with adaptive thinking; 14 of 90 UNSOLVED were found to be graded-wrong solves, so the UNSOLVED label mixes true failures with grader failures. The audit sensitivity (above) shows this does not change the result.
